description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.

 WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.

 Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.

 The Role: We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to create scalable and highly reliable software systems for our production investment pipeline. Successful candidates display an aptitude for improving system availability, latency, performance, efficiency, and capacity measures while also participating in change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning processes. This role will collaborate closely with developers on designing scalable systems, improving release pro cesses, and reducing operational burden from development teams. Site reliability engineers at WorldQuant must be able to adapt to rapid changes in business and technological requirements as well as operate distributed systems in a performant manner.   

   

 What you’ll do:   

 
 Enhance platform reliability by monitoring performance and setting relevant metrics. 

 Own and manage CI/CD procedures, promoting best DevOps practices through standardized release processes. 

 Containerize and scale services to fit business needs. 

 Monitor and manage hardware estate as well as file system. 

 Apply industry standard security practices. 

 Collaborate with engineering teams on both new systems design and existing system enhancements. 

 Pioneer efforts in new open-source technologies while also leveraging mature solutions. 

 Be an active member of an agile engineering team who is continuously looking to improve team performance.   

 
 What You’ll Bring:   

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline or equivalent job experience. 

 Passion toward software engineering and interest in running real-world applications at scale. 

 Mature, thoughtful, with the ability to operate in a collaborative, team-oriented culture 

 Excellent problem-solving abilities and judgment with strong attention to detail 

 Experience in Linux administration; fluent in Linux standard command line programs 

 Familiarity with technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Grafana, Prometheus, Git. 

 Working knowledge in various database and messaging technologies such as SQL, Redis, Kafka 

 Understanding of Git and CI/CD concept 

 Demonstrated experience using Python; understanding of Python idioms and limitations. 

 Strong written and verbal communication skills; Fluency in the English language 

 Candidates need not have prior experience in financial services.   

 
 Notes on schedule: Please note that this role will periodically require coverage until 21:00 Uruguay time to bridge the gap with our Asia hours coverage. We also require light weekend coverage (rotated globally) during daytime hours. We offer flexible work from home hours.
